props.name: children
props.description: Components below call `useAnnounce()` and speak through this region. Optional: without children the region only announces `message`.

props.name: message
props.description: Declarative announcement: each new value is spoken once.

props.name: politeness
props.description: How `message` interrupts: `polite` waits for the reader to pause, `assertive` cuts in. Keep assertive for errors.

props.name: clearAfter
props.description: Milliseconds before the spoken text is cleared from the region. 0 keeps it.
